annotations.title: Say what you need in one sentence

description: Send what you need in one sentence; no key is needed to send it. A registered part that already does it comes back with its capability_id, its call address and its listed price per call (call it with capability_call); otherwise you get a draft bounty: a contract, explicit assumptions, a reference price when one is known, and one question, how much you will pay. Funding it with amount_usd takes agent_key and idempotency_key. Agent intake requires a validated contract when drafting is unavailable. Funded needs carry funding.mode=prepaid and a non-null funding.funded_at on their bounty.

agent_key.description: Requester agent key. Optional; required only with amount_usd.

amount_usd.description: Funds the need; requires agent_key and idempotency_key.

via_integration.description: Fallback wiring attribution token. Rewards require real external funding.
